verdict_reason: The new getPlantsBackendBaseUrl is correct and wired in both Playwright configs, but it leaves the existing getBackendBaseUrl ambiguous about which backend it returns.

todos.issue: getBackendBaseUrl (line 13) reads TRADE_IMPORTS_ANIMALS_BACKEND_URL, but now that getPlantsBackendBaseUrl (line 15) sits beside it the bare 'Backend' no longer tells the reader which backend it returns; the env var says animals, the getter does not, so one concept carries two names (its sole caller is the NotificationApiClient default at adapters/http/notification-api-client.ts:22, which plants fixtures override).
todos.fix: Must: the getter for the animals backend URL names the animals backend, matching its env var and its plants sibling, and every caller uses that name. One way: rename getBackendBaseUrl to getAnimalsBackendBaseUrl and update adapters/http/notification-api-client.ts.
